q: Clinic ke timings kya hain? What are your opening hours?
a: Peer se Hafta subah 10 baje se shaam 6 baje tak khule hain. 1 se 2 baje lunch break hota hai. Itwaar ko clinic band rehta hai.

q: Fees kitni hain? How much does it cost?
a: Checkup Rs 1,500. Scaling aur cleaning Rs 4,000. Filling Rs 3,000 se shuru. Root canal Rs 12,000 se shuru. Final fees doctor mu'ayena ke baad batate hain.

q: Clinic ka address kya hai? Where are you located?
a: Shifa Dental Care, Main Boulevard, Lahore (demo address). Parking building ke peeche maujood hai.

q: Appointment cancel ya reschedule kaise karein? Cancellation policy
a: Kam az kam 4 ghante pehle cancel kar dein, koi charge nahi. Booking ID aur phone number bata kar yahin cancel ho jati hai.

q: Payment ke tareeqe? Which payment methods do you accept?
a: Cash, JazzCash, Easypaisa aur debit/credit card qabool hain.

q: Emergency mein kya karein? Severe pain or swelling
a: Shadeed dard, sujan ya khoon rukne ka naam na le to foran clinic phone karein: 0300-0000000. Hum diagnosis chat par nahi kar sakte.
